Terminal Coding Agent Built from Scratch (C, ~2.3k lines of core code)

GitHub ↗
  • Implemented the ReAct main loop and multi-turn dialogue: an LLM client (HTTP + JSON protocol parsing) drives per-turn tool selection and execution, supporting multiple tool calls per turn with concurrent scheduling.
  • Tool layer: built a tool registry following the dispatch-table pattern, with a unified interface (name, description, parameter schema, executor) for bash / read / write / edit / skill, plus read-only flags and output-length limits.
  • Context management: implemented two switchable strategies—summary compaction (compress old turns into text; saves tokens but loses detail) and offloading (write to external files and read back on demand; preserves raw information at the cost of extra I/O)—both retaining the most recent N turns.
  • Added CUnit unit tests and end-to-end evaluation scripts covering the offload, summary, and executor modules.
